snippet.title: The Pale Piper - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for The Pale Piper, a movement-based story-driven exploration platformer developed by FreeTimeDev. Players will explore an interconnected, dark world, with movement being the only ally. Master timing, momentum, and precision to survive The Pale Piper, launching on February 4 for PC (Steam).
